title: pty cmd v is CSI 118;9u

known.thc-screen/real: terminal: thc_keys.lua sends ⌘V as CSI 118;9u to any process named thc (thc's TUI reads the clipboard itself); thc screen is thc, so fictty gets ⌘V and pastes caretline's own register, not the system clipboard

note: thc's TUI only: in a fictty pane (thc screen) ⌘V is WezTerm's bracketed paste by design, so the raw kitty ⌘V isn't what it gets (E38 covers ⌘V there)
